answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 33323 Country: Pakistan Title: Are women allowed to do full body wax? Can they take help from other woman for the same? Question: Are women allowed to do full body wax? Can they take help from other woman for the same? Answer ID: 33323 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1159/969/B=1432) Yes, a woman can wax her all the body and can take help from other woman as well, but, the other woman should not touch her from below naval to knees. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
